flows.title: Home entry 1 · Order a cargo truck
flows.summary: Entry point: the green Order a cargo truck button on Home. Alex sets pickup and destination, picks a truck, adds cargo and contacts, chooses how to pay, reviews and places the order. LoadMaster offers it to eligible online drivers; Brian accepts in the driver app and Alex sees the assigned driver.

steps.label: Home · entry point. The green Order a cargo truck button (“Set pickup and destination”) starts an immediate order. Next: tap it.
Locations: map with the pickup pin, “Where is the cargo?” and “Where is it going?” prefilled from saved places, plus recent destinations. Next: Continue.
Step 1 of 4 · Truck & destinations: the route, truck sizes (Pickup, Medium, Large), loading helpers at pickup, delivery stops (up to 5) and the estimated total. Next: choose a truck.
Medium truck selected (up to 3 tonnes, covered): the estimated total updates. Next: Cargo & contacts.

Step 2 of 4 · Cargo & contacts: sender (you by default or someone else), cargo items with weight against the truck payload, the recipient at each stop and an optional handover PIN. Next: Payment & pairing.
Step 3 of 4 · Payment & pairing: who pays (you, or the recipient after handover), the payment method and optional pairing with a known driver. Next: Review order.
Step 4 of 4 · Review your order: route, contacts, cargo, the fee breakdown, payer, method and matching. Tick the acknowledgement to enable Order a truck.
The acknowledgement is ticked; the total and Order a truck are ready at the bottom.
Order placed: confirmation with the order number; LoadMaster is finding a driver. Next: Track my order.
POST /orders · order created as Finding a driver and offered to eligible online drivers, one at a time, each with a response countdown
Order screen · Finding a driver: route map, stops, cargo, delivery progress, payment and Cancel order while the cargo is not collected.
Driver app · Brian taps Review request: pickup, stops, cargo, truck, his earning and the response countdown.
Driver app · Accept this order: the trip is Brian's and moves to his Deliveries.
Customer app · the order now shows Brian as the driver, his truck and the handover codes.
Messages & quick replies: chat with the assigned driver about this order, with one-tap quick replies.

flows.title: Home entry 2 · Schedule pickup
flows.summary: Entry point: the Schedule pickup tile on Home. Same order wizard as Order a cargo truck, with a pickup date and time chosen up front. The order is saved as scheduled and dispatched to drivers closer to the pickup time.

steps.label: Home · entry point. The Schedule pickup tile (first of the three shortcuts) books a truck for later. Next: tap it.
Locations · “Schedule your pickup.”: pickup and destination plus Pickup date & time, with Change date and Change time. Next: Continue.
Step 1 of 4 · Truck & destinations for the scheduled trip: route, truck size, helpers, stops and estimate. Next: Cargo & contacts.

Step 2 of 4 · Cargo & contacts: sender (you by default or someone else), cargo items with weight against the truck payload, the recipient at each stop and an optional handover PIN. Next: Payment & pairing.
Step 3 of 4 · Payment & pairing: who pays (you, or the recipient after handover), the payment method and optional pairing with a known driver. Next: Review order.
Step 4 of 4 · Review your order: route, contacts, cargo, the fee breakdown, payer, method and matching. Tick the acknowledgement to enable Order a truck.
The acknowledgement is ticked; the total and Order a truck are ready at the bottom.
Pickup scheduled: the order number is booked and LoadMaster starts finding a driver before pickup. Next: Track my order.
POST /orders (scheduledAt) · order saved as Scheduled; dispatch to drivers starts near the pickup time
Order screen · Scheduled: the scheduled pickup date and time; eligible drivers receive the request when it is due.
Orders tab lists the trip as Scheduled.

flows.title: Home entry 3 · Order again
flows.summary: Entry point: the Order again tile on Home. Alex picks a past trip; its route, cargo and contacts are copied into the order wizard to review and edit, and a fresh price is calculated before ordering.

steps.label: Home · entry point. The Order again tile (middle shortcut) repeats a past trip. Next: tap it.
Order again: completed, returned and cancelled trips, newest first, each with route, date, status and price. Next: choose a trip.
A delivered trip is chosen: Locations opens prefilled with its pickup and destination. Next: Continue.
Step 1 of 4 · the past trip's truck, loading helpers and stops are preselected; a fresh estimate is shown. Next: Cargo & contacts.
Step 2 of 4 · cargo items, sender and recipients copied from the past trip, ready to edit. Next: Payment & pairing.
Step 3 of 4 · the past trip's payment method is preselected. Next: Review order.
Step 4 of 4 · Review your order: route, contacts, cargo, the fee breakdown, payer, method and matching. Tick the acknowledgement to enable Order a truck.
The acknowledgement is ticked; the total and Order a truck are ready at the bottom.
Order placed: confirmation with the new order number. Next: Track my order.
POST /orders · a new order with a fresh quote; the past trip is unchanged
Order screen · Finding a driver for the repeated trip.

flows.title: Home entry 4 · Use a driver ID
flows.summary: Entry point: the Use a driver ID tile on Home. Alex enters a driver's short number (Brian is 2001). LoadMaster checks the driver is verified, online, free and has a big enough truck, then the order goes to that driver first; Brian accepts and is assigned.

steps.label: Home · entry point. The Use a driver ID tile (third shortcut) sends an order straight to a driver you know. Next: tap it.

Unknown number: “Check the driver's short number.” Nothing is sent until a valid driver is found.
POST /account/pair · resolves the short number; refuses drivers who are offline, busy, unverified or whose truck is too small (8 attempts a minute)
Brian (2001) is available: Locations opens with his truck size carried over. Next: Continue.
Step 1 of 4 · Truck & destinations, preset to Brian's truck size. Next: Cargo & contacts.

Step 2 of 4 · Cargo & contacts: sender (you by default or someone else), cargo items with weight against the truck payload, the recipient at each stop and an optional handover PIN. Next: Payment & pairing.
Step 3 of 4 · Your matched driver: Brian Kato with his truck and plate, awaiting his consent after ordering. Use automatic matching switches back. Next: Review order.
Step 4 of 4 · Review your order shows “Pair with Brian Kato” as matching. Tick the acknowledgement.
The acknowledgement is ticked; the total and Order a truck are ready at the bottom.
Order placed. Next: Track my order.

flows.summary: Delivery creates a payment attempt. Uncertain results are checked before retrying. The payer can be the customer or the stop-1 recipient.

steps.label: Final stop delivered
Approve
Delayed → check status
Recipient payer → share link
Receipt
Collection Paid
Entitlement Scheduled

flows.title: 7 · Cash collection & remittance
flows.summary: For cash orders the driver records cash received, the payer confirms it, and finance records the platform-fee remittance. The driver’s retained earning is never paid twice.

steps.label: Record cash received
Confirm cash payment
Cash reconciliation · remittance
Earning retained

flows.title: 8 · Driver releases an accepted delivery
flows.summary: Before loading, a driver can back out. The order returns to searching instead of being cancelled.

steps.label: Release this delivery
Reason · confirm
stage → searching · dispatch released
“Finding a new driver”
Released + reason

flows.title: 9 · Customer cancels
flows.summary: Allowed until cargo is collected. Open offers are withdrawn so drivers see why the request disappeared.

steps.label: Confirm cancellation
stage → cancelled · offers withdrawn
“Customer cancelled the order”
Status Cancelled

flows.title: 10 · Delivery messages
flows.summary: After acceptance, customer and driver exchange messages and quick replies on the order.

steps.label: Send message
Messages & quick replies

flows.title: 11 · Driver onboarding & approval
flows.summary: Drivers submit vehicle and four documents; staff review and approve, then the driver can go online.

steps.label: Verification needed
Upload documents
Review · approve
Go online
Availability Online

flows.title: 12 · Operations reassigns a driver
flows.summary: Staff with trip access can assign any verified online driver with a suitable truck before cargo is collected.

steps.label: Manage assignment
Choose driver + reason
Old driver: “Order reassigned”
New driver: delivery screen
“Driver updated”

flows.title: 13 · Driver payout request
flows.summary: Drivers request all scheduled earnings; finance approves and pays every included trip, or rejects with a reason.

steps.label: Scheduled earnings
Request payout
Approve & pay
“Payout request paid”

flows.title: 14 · Live tracking across all three apps
flows.summary: Each driver stage update moves the truck on the customer map, the admin fleet map and the admin trip page within one poll (customer 2 s, admin 4 s). Positions are simulated from the stage.

steps.label: Advance stage
Stage saved · timeline entry · audit
Progress + map update
Pin moves · trip panel
Route map · stops

flows.title: 15 · Operations manage a driver account
flows.summary: From the driver page, staff with “Edit, suspend and deactivate accounts” can set a driver offline, revoke verification, suspend, deactivate or reset a password. Each needs a reason and is audited.

steps.label: Find driver · open row
Driver page
More → Set offline / Suspend
Open offers withdrawn · sessions revoked · audit
Offline · “You were set offline”
Attributed to the staff member

flows.title: 16 · Super Admin edits a role
flows.summary: Roles are records with permissions. Editing one changes what everyone in it can see and do on their next request; sections they lose are not rendered at all.

steps.label: Roles table · Edit
Choose permissions
Role saved · holders re-scoped · audit
Holder sees new columns/actions

machines.title: Driver request (dispatch) outcomes
transitions: taken by another / cancelled / driver offline

sync: All three apps read one shared order record from the demo service.
Customer & Driver apps poll GET /snapshot every 2 s and on app foreground; Admin polls GET /admin every 4 s.
Mutations call refresh() immediately; a refresh requested during a poll is queued, not dropped.
Real-time = within one poll interval. Push/websockets are not implemented.

kids.t: Control which payment methods LoadMaster accepts across the customer and driver apps.

Disable a method during an outage to remove it from new payment and withdrawal choices. Pending confirmations, receipts and refunds remain available for reconciliation. Availability updates reach connected apps on their next refresh.

kids.t: Office approval followed by finance disbursement. Provider payments are simulated.
How to review and pay a withdrawal
Verify the driver's amount and destination, then approve or reject the request.
Finance records the provider result and transfer reference. Approval leaves the money awaiting payment.
For a pending result, check the same transfer before attempting another payment. A confirmed failure can be retried or rejected.
Record the charge and payer. For example, a UGX 10,000 withdrawal with a UGX 500 driver-paid charge delivers UGX 9,500. When LoadMaster covers the charge, the driver receives UGX 10,000.
Use a payouts reconciliation report to compare net transfers and charges with provider records.

kids.t: Office approval followed by finance disbursement. Provider payments are simulated.
How to review and pay a withdrawal
Verify the driver's amount and destination, then approve or reject the request.
Finance records the provider result and transfer reference. Approval leaves the money awaiting payment.
For a pending result, check the same transfer before attempting another payment. A confirmed failure can be retried or rejected.
Record the charge and payer. For example, a UGX 10,000 withdrawal with a UGX 500 driver-paid charge delivers UGX 9,500. When LoadMaster covers the charge, the driver receives UGX 10,000.
Use a payouts reconciliation report to compare net transfers and charges with provider records.

kids.t: Choose collections, payouts or refunds and the provider and dates covered by the provider file. Cash and LoadMaster wallet payments are tracked in the ledger.
Compare the provider reference and amount. For payouts, also compare the charge and net amount received.
Open the linked trip or withdrawal to inspect its attempts. Resolve an awaiting confirmation only after verifying the provider evidence.
Import again after a correction to compare the current records. Earlier imports retain their original comparison and any resolution notes.

kids.t: Choose collections, payouts or refunds and the provider and dates covered by the provider file. Cash and LoadMaster wallet payments are tracked in the ledger.
Compare the provider reference and amount. For payouts, also compare the charge and net amount received.
Open the linked trip or withdrawal to inspect its attempts. Resolve an awaiting confirmation only after verifying the provider evidence.
Import again after a correction to compare the current records. Earlier imports retain their original comparison and any resolution notes.

kids.t: Pricing and dispatch rules for new trips.

All accounts and financial outcomes in this workspace are synthetic. No provider, production database, SMS or email integration is active. Driver locations on the operations map are explicitly simulated.
Loading and offloading are itemized independently. Complex equipment, stairs and heavy handling need an assisted quote. The current demo applies the configured platform fee to the full quote.

kids.t: A little help goes a long way.
How do I order a truck?
Choose pickup and destination, select a suitable truck, confirm handling and payment method, then tap Order a truck.
Transport only means you arrange handling. Add helpers at pickup, destination, or both before ordering. Stairs, heavy equipment and complex loads need an assisted quote.
The demo payment starts after delivery is confirmed. Mobile Money and card outcomes are simulated; no real payment is sent.
Check the current payment status. Do not start another payment while the first outcome is uncertain.
Choose the right capacity before setting your route.

Choose an amount and destination. Office reviews your request, then finance sends your payment. The payout record shows the provider charge, who covers it, and the amount you receive. Charges are confirmed by finance. Payments are simulated in this demo.
Enter the amount to remove from your earnings. If you cover a provider charge, it is deducted from this amount.
Requests you accept, decline or miss are kept here.
A good move is worth sharing.

kids.t: Sign in to your connected cargo experience.
Prototype environment. Use synthetic details; no real payments or identity verification take place.
A little help goes a long way.
How do I order a truck?
Choose pickup and destination, select a suitable truck, confirm handling and payment method, then tap Order a truck.
Transport only means you arrange handling. Add helpers at pickup, destination, or both before ordering. Stairs, heavy equipment and complex loads need an assisted quote.
The demo payment starts after delivery is confirmed. Mobile Money and card outcomes are simulated; no real payment is sent.
Check the current payment status. Do not start another payment while the first outcome is uncertain.

kids.t: See how to earn and use rewards.
Demo payments only. No real money is collected. Your wallet balance and order payments are shown separately.
Enter a whole amount between UGX 1 and UGX 1,000,000.
Payment is due after handover. A recipient payer must accept and approve through the demo payment link. Their phone number alone does not authorize payment.
Driver records cash received; the payer confirms it. Collection and platform-fee remittance are tracked separately.
per location. No duplicated pickup fee per package. Quote expires
Illustrative trucks. Your assigned vehicle is confirmed after driver acceptance.

kids.t: Illustrative trucks. Your assigned vehicle is confirmed after driver acceptance.
Pickup loading is charged once for the agreed load.
Payment is due after handover. A recipient payer must accept and approve through the demo payment link. Their phone number alone does not authorize payment.
Driver records cash received; the payer confirms it. Collection and platform-fee remittance are tracked separately.
per location. No duplicated pickup fee per package. Quote expires
per location. No duplicated pickup fee per package. Quote expires
I confirm the cargo, contacts, route, fees and selected payment method.
Prototype terms acknowledgement. Failed delivery or returns require support review; no automatic extra return charge or disposal rule is applied.
Drivers usually accept quickly. Once matched, you can follow every stop and share handover codes from the order screen.

Driver records cash received; the payer confirms it. Collection and platform-fee remittance are tracked separately.
FlexiPay, external wallets and card/Mobile Money providers are simulated. Do not enter real credentials or payment PINs.
Optional. The driver must be verified, online, free and able to carry this truck size. They must still accept your order.

kids.t: Illustrative trucks. Your assigned vehicle is confirmed after driver acceptance.
Pickup loading is charged once for the agreed load.
Payment is due after handover. A recipient payer must accept and approve through the demo payment link. Their phone number alone does not authorize payment.
Driver records cash received; the payer confirms it. Collection and platform-fee remittance are tracked separately.
per location. No duplicated pickup fee per package. Quote expires
per location. No duplicated pickup fee per package. Quote expires
I confirm the cargo, contacts, route, fees and selected payment method.
Prototype terms acknowledgement. Failed delivery or returns require support review; no automatic extra return charge or disposal rule is applied.
Drivers usually accept quickly. Once matched, you can follow every stop and share handover codes from the order screen.

kids.t: Illustrative trucks. Your assigned vehicle is confirmed after driver acceptance.
Pickup loading is charged once for the agreed load.
Payment is due after handover. A recipient payer must accept and approve through the demo payment link. Their phone number alone does not authorize payment.
Driver records cash received; the payer confirms it. Collection and platform-fee remittance are tracked separately.
per location. No duplicated pickup fee per package. Quote expires
I confirm the cargo, contacts, route, fees and selected payment method.
Prototype terms acknowledgement. Failed delivery or returns require support review; no automatic extra return charge or disposal rule is applied.
Drivers usually accept quickly. Once matched, you can follow every stop and share handover codes from the order screen.

kids.t: Office approval followed by finance disbursement. Provider payments are simulated.
How to review and pay a withdrawal
Verify the driver's amount and destination, then approve or reject the request.
Finance records the provider result and transfer reference. Approval leaves the money awaiting payment.
For a pending result, check the same transfer before attempting another payment. A confirmed failure can be retried or rejected.
Record the charge and payer. For example, a UGX 10,000 withdrawal with a UGX 500 driver-paid charge delivers UGX 9,500. When LoadMaster covers the charge, the driver receives UGX 10,000.
Use a payouts reconciliation report to compare net transfers and charges with provider records.

kids.t: Office approval followed by finance disbursement. Provider payments are simulated.
How to review and pay a withdrawal
Verify the driver's amount and destination, then approve or reject the request.
Finance records the provider result and transfer reference. Approval leaves the money awaiting payment.
For a pending result, check the same transfer before attempting another payment. A confirmed failure can be retried or rejected.
Record the charge and payer. For example, a UGX 10,000 withdrawal with a UGX 500 driver-paid charge delivers UGX 9,500. When LoadMaster covers the charge, the driver receives UGX 10,000.
Use a payouts reconciliation report to compare net transfers and charges with provider records.

kids.t: Office approval followed by finance disbursement. Provider payments are simulated.
How to review and pay a withdrawal
Verify the driver's amount and destination, then approve or reject the request.
Finance records the provider result and transfer reference. Approval leaves the money awaiting payment.
For a pending result, check the same transfer before attempting another payment. A confirmed failure can be retried or rejected.
Record the charge and payer. For example, a UGX 10,000 withdrawal with a UGX 500 driver-paid charge delivers UGX 9,500. When LoadMaster covers the charge, the driver receives UGX 10,000.
Use a payouts reconciliation report to compare net transfers and charges with provider records.

kids.t: Choose an amount and destination. Office reviews your request, then finance sends your payment. The payout record shows the provider charge, who covers it, and the amount you receive. Charges are confirmed by finance. Payments are simulated in this demo.
. Complete this request before submitting another.
Enter the amount to remove from your earnings. If you cover a provider charge, it is deducted from this amount.

kids.t: Choose collections, payouts or refunds and the provider and dates covered by the provider file. Cash and LoadMaster wallet payments are tracked in the ledger.
Compare the provider reference and amount. For payouts, also compare the charge and net amount received.
Open the linked trip or withdrawal to inspect its attempts. Resolve an awaiting confirmation only after verifying the provider evidence.
Import again after a correction to compare the current records. Earlier imports retain their original comparison and any resolution notes.

kids.t: Choose collections, payouts or refunds and the provider and dates covered by the provider file. Cash and LoadMaster wallet payments are tracked in the ledger.
Compare the provider reference and amount. For payouts, also compare the charge and net amount received.
Open the linked trip or withdrawal to inspect its attempts. Resolve an awaiting confirmation only after verifying the provider evidence.
Import again after a correction to compare the current records. Earlier imports retain their original comparison and any resolution notes.

kids.t: Full access, including staff and roles.
A little help goes a long way.
How do I order a truck?
Choose pickup and destination, select a suitable truck, confirm handling and payment method, then tap Order a truck.
Transport only means you arrange handling. Add helpers at pickup, destination, or both before ordering. Stairs, heavy equipment and complex loads need an assisted quote.
The demo payment starts after delivery is confirmed. Mobile Money and card outcomes are simulated; no real payment is sent.
Check the current payment status. Do not start another payment while the first outcome is uncertain.

kids.t: Choose collections, payouts or refunds and the provider and dates covered by the provider file. Cash and LoadMaster wallet payments are tracked in the ledger.
Compare the provider reference and amount. For payouts, also compare the charge and net amount received.
Open the linked trip or withdrawal to inspect its attempts. Resolve an awaiting confirmation only after verifying the provider evidence.
Import again after a correction to compare the current records. Earlier imports retain their original comparison and any resolution notes.
